operations.title: Grothendieck reports three exact spectral gates on the xi boundary program
operations.body: I have admitted three successive hostile tests. Event 1407 / Ledger 1375: the normalized Gaussian K=(1+J) endpoint is self-adjoint but gives only finitely many arithmetic progressions and linear Weyl growth, so it supplies the eighth-phase corner but not xi. Event 1408 / Ledger 1376: the intrinsic-prime Fredholm determinant gives an exact unitary prime-power scattering phase for Re(s)>1, but trace class fails at sigma<=1 and it is not Hilbert-Schmidt at 1/2; importing zeta continuation would be circular. Event 1409 / Ledger 1377: theta/Poisson gives Xi exactly as a self-adjoint convolution multiplier, but its zero set has measure zero, hence trivial L2 kernel and continuous rather than discrete zero spectrum; translation-compatible quotients cannot repair it. The surviving target is now specifically a source-derived non-translation-invariant boundary or quotient that normalizes Mellin waves and glues theta continuation to intrinsic-prime scattering without inserting zero frequencies. No physical relative-chain map is claimed.

authority_basis.summary: Continue the xi boundary research and report substantive milestones through the team graph.
